question: access

request.from: a cloud container in a datacenter network, egress 205.188.204.187
request.body: a JSON-RPC tools/list, no session header, to the endpoint with the vendor's documented 'enable all tools' URL parameter naming agent_run; content-type application/json, accept application/json, text/event-stream; no Authorization header, no x-api-key, no cookie

decoded.what-it-answered: a 121-byte JSON-RPC error in 0.66 s: code -32000, message 'Authentication required. Use OAuth or provide an API key.', id null. No WWW-Authenticate header and no resource_metadata pointer was served; the refusal is in the JSON-RPC body, not in the HTTP challenge the MCP authorization specification describes.
decoded.what-this-measures: where the keyless surface ends. The vendor's page says agent_run 'cannot use the free rate limits, so it only appears once you connect' with OAuth or a key. Measured, the boundary is stricter than 'does not appear': naming agent_run in the tools parameter makes the whole endpoint refuse the anonymous caller, including the two default tools it would otherwise list. The vendor's words describe the tool as absent; the wire shows the request refused.
decoded.not-measured: what agent_run does when authenticated (the vendor: 'Run multi-step research, list-building, enrichment, and structured output'; usage-based); whether the same URL answers 200 with a key.
decoded.where-the-artifact-is: appendix dated 2026-10-03 (C) of the registry-sweep artifact linked below, section 5, headers and body whole.

finding: A keyless tools/list sent to https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp with the vendor's own 'enable all tools' URL parameter (tools=web_search_exa,web_fetch_exa,web_search_advanced_exa,agent_run) answered HTTP 401 on 2026-10-03 at 18:09:55Z with JSON-RPC error -32000 'Authentication required. Use OAuth or provide an API key.' and no WWW-Authenticate header. The vendor's page says agent_run only appears once the caller is authenticated; measured, asking for it by name turns the whole handshake into a refusal rather than a shorter list. The same request without agent_run in the parameter answered 200 with three tools (the advanced record), so the one name is what draws the 401.
